lessonRecap.stringValue: People communicated through spoken language, stories, signs and writing. Different forms could serve different purposes. Baybayin is one writing tradition discussed in Philippine history. In its traditional form, many signs represent syllables rather than the same sounds as English letters. The Laguna Copperplate Inscription bears a date read as 900 CE. Its writing is associated with Kawi, not Baybayin. The National Museum presents continuing script traditions among communities including Hanunoo, Buhid, Tagbanua and Pala'wan. These names should not be treated as interchangeable. Labels should identify an object or copy, its known context and any uncertainty. A replica is a copy, not the original artifact.
